answer: Sybil resistance links equivocation evidence across bonded identities: when k coordinated identities sign conflicting histories, the protocol assesses pairwise correlated penalties, producing O(k^2) liability rather than k independent fines. Detection can also compound escrow seizure with asymmetric depreciation, so controlling a sybil swarm incurs an exponential multiplier in capital loss. A shared control vertex can expose the vine of linked claims, making isolated identity-level defenses ineffective even at the summit of apparent decentralization.
